name: zinput_di_add_joystick_ref
description: zInput::DI_AddJoystickRef increments the joystick poll reference count only when joystick polling is enabled, resetting transition state on the first enabled reference.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x471d50 returns the current refcount unchanged when g_zInputJoystickFlags bit 0 is clear; when the bit is set, it calls DI_ResetTransitionState only for a zero refcount, increments the 16-bit refcount, and returns it.

Native smoke zinput_joystick_ref_and_enable_smoke verifies disabled AddJoystickRef leaves the count at zero, first enabled AddJoystickRef resets joystick transition state and returns one, second enabled AddJoystickRef returns two, and releases decrement back to zero.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x471d50 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a zInput joystick reference-count pass.
